testimonial.name: Marcus Ellison
testimonial.review: Three months in and the difference in my daily energy is night and day. I used to hit a wall around 2 PM every afternoon—now I push through my workouts and still have gas in the tank for my kids after dinner. Tenor fits right into my routine without any jitters or crash.
testimonial.persona: 38-year-old father of two who works in construction management and trains at a local gym four mornings a week; looking for steady energy and vitality support that doesn't interfere with his demanding schedule.
